column2: aptus data-acquisition brief target 1 — Fiori Apps Library reference data
https://fal.cloud.sap/  (SAP Fiori Apps Reference Library, FAL 2.0)
releaseId eq 'S37'  = Releases.releaseName "S/4HANA Cloud 2608", externalName "2608", releaseType SC
all 5854 rows carry releaseGroupText "SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud" (no other group present under S37)
complete for this filter: FuzzySearch/$count?$filter=releaseId eq 'S37' returned 5854 and 5854 rows were paged out; 5854 distinct app_id, no duplicates.

floor with respect to SAP overall: only apps FAL publishes under release S37 are here. Apps SAP has not attached to this release, and any app absent from FAL, are not counted and their number cannot be measured from this service.
anonymous OData v2 reads of the Fiori Apps Library's own published data service ($top/$skip/$select/$orderby). No login, no DOM scraping, no api.sap.com traffic.
app_type=FuzzySearch.AppType (FAL "App Type"; UITechnology and AppTypeLevel are separate FAL fields, not merged in)
lob=FuzzySearch.GTMLoBName (FAL "Line of Business" filter field). FAL also publishes LeadingLob (single-valued, non-empty on 2172 rows vs 2053 here); the two were NOT merged.
odata_services=RequiredODataServices.TechnicalName (OData V2/V4 services) UNION FuzzySearch.ODataV4GroupServiceName (V4 service groups), pipe-joined, V2/V4-service names first
required_scope_item_ids=FuzzySearch.ScopeItemID, re-joined with "|" (SAP already pipe-delimits this field)
availability=FuzzySearch.isPublished (values observed: Published, Deprecated). FAL's availabilityInFaaS field is "false" on all 5854 rows and was not used.
app_hub_url=constructed from SAP's own FAL 1.0->2.0 parameter map published at /sap/fix/externalViewer/ (appid->app-id, releaseId->release-version). DERIVED URL, not a field SAP returns.

| (pipe) on every multi-valued column. SAP returns app_type, lob and device_types comma-separated and required_scope_item_ids pipe-separated; the delimiter was normalised to | and no value was otherwise altered.
an empty cell means the field was empty in the source, never that it was unknown or dropped
this file states what SAP publishes for release 2608. It says nothing about what any tenant has activated.
